name: cyclin dependent kinase inhibitor 2B

function.text: CDKN2B encodes cyclin-dependent kinase 4 inhibitor B. Annotated molecular activities include cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase inhibitor activity and protein kinase binding. It participates in cellular senescence and megakaryocyte differentiation.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Meningioma, CNS WHO grade 3; Biphasic hyalinizing psammomatous / NF2-inactivated renal cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
